mentions.name: Wall of Pizza (OpenBSD sponsorship page)
mentions.description: A personal sponsorship effort by a long-time OpenBSD contributor: a 'wall of pizza' page that solicits monthly sponsors and one-off donations (including bitcoin) to fund more of their time on open source development and advocacy, using their own hand-built HTML page to attract supporters.
mentions.problem: Needs to make rent while doing unpaid open source work, which limits the time available for OpenBSD development and advocacy.
mentions.audience: Individuals, companies, and donors willing to sponsor open source development
mentions.source_excerpt:
If any individuals, companies (or bitcoin millionaires) would like to help a long-time OpenBSD slacker, unslack, I'd really like to focus more of my time on open source development (and advocacy), rather than making rent. Feel free to contact me.

https://brynet.ca/wallofpizza.html
mentions.author: brynet
